name: Planeswalkers
description: A planeswalker in each colour and five more in colour pairs, plus a few cards that protect them or reward you for playing them.

cards.name: Halvene, Dawn Warden
cards.rule_text:
+1: Create a 1/1 white Soldier creature token.
−3: Exile target creature or enchantment an opponent controls.
−7: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +2/+2 and have vigilance."

cards.name: Quillon, Archivist of Tides
cards.rule_text:
+1: Draw a card, then put a card from your hand on top of your library.
−2: Return target nonland permanent to its owner's hand.
−7: You get an emblem with "Whenever an opponent casts their first spell each turn, counter that spell unless its controller pays {3}."

cards.name: Nethra, Grave Singer
cards.rule_text:
+1: Each opponent loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.
−3: Destroy target creature.
−8: You get an emblem with "At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, that player sacrifices a creature of their choice."

cards.name: Tarrik, Ember-Hand
cards.rule_text:
+1: Discard up to one card, then draw a card.
−2: CARDNAME deals 3 damage to target creature or planeswalker.
−7: You get an emblem with "Whenever you cast an instant or sorcery spell, this emblem deals 2 damage to any target."

cards.name: Fennick, Grove-Speaker
cards.rule_text:
+1: Look at the top card of your library. If it's a creature or land card, you may reveal it and put it into your hand.
−2: Create a 3/3 green Beast creature token.
−7: You get an emblem with "Creatures you control get +3/+3 and have trample."

cards.name: Elsabet, Keeper of the Accord
cards.rule_text:
+1: Tap up to one target creature. It doesn't untap during its controller's next untap step.
−2: Draw two cards.
−8: Exile all nonland permanents your opponents control.

cards.name: Draskel, the Grinning Flame
cards.rule_text:
+1: Create a 1/1 red Devil creature token with "When this creature dies, it deals 1 damage to any target."
−2: Each opponent sacrifices a creature of their choice.
−7: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control dies, each opponent loses 2 life."

cards.name: Seldra, Voice of the Meadow
cards.rule_text:
+1: Put a +1/+1 counter on each of up to two target creatures.
−2: Create a 2/2 green Wolf creature token. You gain 2 life.
−6: You get an emblem with "Whenever a creature you control enters, put two +1/+1 counters on it."

cards.name: Zephrin, the Restless Spark
cards.rule_text:
+1: Draw a card, then discard a card.
−3: CARDNAME deals damage to target creature or planeswalker equal to the number of instant and sorcery cards in your graveyard.
−7: You get an emblem with "Instant and sorcery spells you cast cost {1} less to cast."

cards.name: Ossia, Mother of Mould
cards.rule_text:
+1: Create a 1/1 green Saproling creature token.
−2: Return target creature or planeswalker card from your graveyard to your hand.
−7: Return all creature cards from your graveyard to the battlefield.

cards.name: Oathsworn Shieldbearer
cards.rule_text:
Vigilance
Planeswalkers you control have hexproof.
cards.flavor_text: Her oath was to one person, not to a kingdom.

cards.name: Sparkstone Lens
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{2}, {T}: Put a loyalty counter on target planeswalker you control. Activate only as a sorcery.

cards.name: Rekindle the Oaths
cards.flavor_text: A promise grows stronger each time it is kept.

cards.name: Thornward Keeper
cards.rule_text:
Reach
Whenever you activate a loyalty ability, put a +1/+1 counter on CARDNAME.

cards.name: Hall of Many Sparks
cards.rule_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{T}: Add one mana of any color. Spend this mana only to cast planeswalker spells.
